title: loadng discovery: forged-RREP route poisoning — proxy flag never validated, seq ownership unverified
description: discovery.py:178-207 treats wire seq_num as authoritative; process_rrep ignores flags entirely. Hostile neighbor sends RREP(originator=D,seq=fresher,hop=1)→victim installs attacker route; poisoned grad.seq_num then emitted via proxy replies suppressing genuine discovery. Needs destination-owned sequence verification (authoritative flag + pinned key) or treat proxy replies as non-installing hints.
